reason: The first task is free and I like piloting new tools, so I'd try one copy task with a real brief just to see how the judge scores. I wouldn't pay for a second one until I've seen the entries and the score reasons.
objection: Writing a good rubric for each task is extra effort for me, and I'm not sure an AI judge can score copy quality the way I would. It's also USDC on Solana with no audit, so paying for it would be a hassle with finance.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a sample task where the winning entry was clearly good copy I'd actually use, and being able to pay by card instead of USDC.
